assessment: Historical fixed-reference assessment authored before native outcome inspection; not ex-ante adoption measurement.

designer-drift-audit.goal: Keep the workflow designer synchronized with authoritative aw reference documents.
designer-drift-audit.partial: Distinct explicitly written repository-local documentation references repaired from a nonexistent file to an existing file in a native parent/child transition.
designer-drift-audit.strict: Every reported drift item independently resolved, all seven source audit categories accurate, no false positive drift assertions.
designer-drift-audit.historicalApplicability: Parent and child workflow source must both contain the designer synchronization goal and stale-reference audit.

daily-doc-healer.goal: Detect and fix confirmed documentation gaps missed by the updater and improve its rules.
daily-doc-healer.partial: Distinct repository-local Markdown cross-reference targets repaired from a nonexistent file to an existing file in a native parent/child transition.
daily-doc-healer.strict: A recently closed documentation issue missed by the updater has a confirmed content gap completely repaired without violating rejection, experimental-engine or site-build exemptions; recurrence rules improved when warranted.
daily-doc-healer.historicalApplicability: Parent and child workflow source must both contain the healer mission to detect gaps missed by DDUw. A reference repair alone does not establish the healer opportunity prerequisites.

daily-doc-updater.goal: Maintain accurate and complete user documentation as features and behavior change.
daily-doc-updater.partial: Distinct repository-local Markdown cross-reference targets repaired from a nonexistent file to an existing file in a native parent/child transition.
daily-doc-updater.strict: Confirmed user-facing documentation gap fully repaired against the implementation, structurally valid examples, current terminology and documentation guidelines, no protected-file edits.
daily-doc-updater.historicalApplicability: Parent and child workflow source must both contain the mission to update documentation based on recent code changes.

partialRules.nativeCheck: Parse only explicit Markdown inline links without titles or escaped/nested destinations, or backtick-quoted literal repository paths. Resolve relative paths against the containing document; repository-root literals against the tree. Require an explicit Markdown extension and a regular target blob. Reject external URLs, anchors, directories, variable templates and ambiguous syntax.
partialRules.transition: Within a changed scoped document, compare before-only unresolved destinations and after-only resolved destinations at the same reference site; accept only an unambiguous one-to-one substitution with otherwise identical line context, or an unchanged reference whose previously missing target is added. Require both whole trees and exact native parent/child objects. Never count deletion of a broken reference as repair.
partialRules.deduplication: Count each document plus old/new target transition once over retained history, not once per snapshot or repeated mention.
partialRules.period: Seven-day non-overlapping cutoff-aligned intervals; transition timestamp must lie in [start,end). At most two native changes per workflow in initial cohort.
partialRules.unknown: Missing objects, unassessed history, incompatible source eras, insufficient lineage and full semantic correctness remain null; zero only for an actually assessed scoped case.
partialRules.attribution: Repository movement is independent of actor. Discovery references are candidates only. No workflow contribution without corroborated original lineage; no receipt-verified credit without creation evidence.
partialRules.safeguards: A local file existing proves neither route validity, anchor correctness, prose correctness, rendered usability nor general documentation completeness.
partialRules.cost: Not measured; no weights, monetary conversion or keep threshold.
